giver: Nobody: they're in the book from the start, for anyone who wants them.
feel: Pointless standalone quests for fun, with token rewards.

quests.title: Take a Seat
quests.summary: Sit in a Handcrafted chair, on an Another Furniture bench and on a Let's Do sofa. That's it.

quests.title: Gerald
quests.summary: Name a piece of cobblestone 'Gerald' at an anvil and keep him in your inventory for seven days.

quests.title: Bonk
quests.summary: Hit a target dummy one hundred times. It doesn't mind.

quests.title: Pumpkin Head
quests.summary: Wear a carved pumpkin on your head for a whole day and night.

quests.title: Too Much Cake
quests.summary: Build a Bakery cake tower three tiers high, and don't eat any of it.

quests.title: Every Colour
quests.summary: Dye sixteen sheep sixteen different colours and get them in one pen.

quests.title: Squeaky Clean
quests.summary: Craft Supplementaries soap and wash the dye off something that really didn't need washing.

quests.title: Busker
quests.summary: Play a whole song on an Immersive Melodies instrument in a village square. Nobody claps.

quests.title: Pig Ferry
quests.summary: Ride a pig across a river with a carrot on a stick, and stay dry.

quests.title: Summit Flower
quests.summary: Put a flower pot with a flower in it on the very highest block of a village.

quests.title: Rain Dance
quests.summary: Stand outside, uncovered, through a whole thunderstorm.

quests.title: Ducks in a Row
quests.summary: Get five ducks to stand in a straight line. Leads allowed.
